related.title: Galileo 衛星定位系統
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：解算必須包含三維位置及時鐘未知數；只用三個偽距而假定完美時鐘須明示限制。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The solution must include 3-D position and clock unknowns; a three-range perfect-clock assumption must be explicit. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 分離測距精度與衛星幾何稀釋效應，避免只按衛星顆數選解。
related.differenceEn: Separate range precision from geometric dilution and avoid choosing solutions by satellite count alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學光速取 3×10⁸ m/s，接收器時鐘慢或快的符號另定，偏差大小 20 ns。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：|δρ|=3×10⁸×20×10⁻⁹。 結果約 6 m。偽距包含幾何距離加 cδt；所有衛星共用的接收器時鐘偏差不等於每軸位置誤差。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成測距 1σ=3 m、PDOP=2.5，指三維位置誤差尺度。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：σ位置=2.5×3。 結果約 7.5 m。等方差線性化近似 σ位置≈PDOP×σ測距；相關誤差或非線性偏差需另建模。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching c=3×10⁸ m/s and clock-bias magnitude 20 ns, defining sign separately. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: |δρ|=3×10⁸×20×10⁻⁹. Result ≈ 6 m. Pseudorange includes geometric range plus cδt; common receiver-clock bias is not a per-axis position error.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic range 1σ is 3 m and PDOP=2.5, representing a 3-D position error scale. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: σposition=2.5×3. Result ≈ 7.5 m. Under equal-variance linearization σposition≈PDOP×σrange; correlated errors and nonlinear bias need separate models.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 深空地面站通訊工程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：解算必須包含三維位置及時鐘未知數；只用三個偽距而假定完美時鐘須明示限制。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The solution must include 3-D position and clock unknowns; a three-range perfect-clock assumption must be explicit. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 把接收時窗取聯集後計算唯一資料容量，避免重疊時段重複計帳。
related.differenceEn: Calculate unique data capacity from the union of contact windows without double-counting overlap.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學光速取 3×10⁸ m/s，接收器時鐘慢或快的符號另定，偏差大小 20 ns。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：|δρ|=3×10⁸×20×10⁻⁹。 結果約 6 m。偽距包含幾何距離加 cδt；所有衛星共用的接收器時鐘偏差不等於每軸位置誤差。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學兩站窗口為 0–30 和 20–50 min，唯一資料率 2 Mbit/s，不含封包負擔。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：V=(30+30−10)×60×2/8。 結果約 750 MB。固定唯一資料率下容量=聯集時間×資料率；重複接收同一資料不增加唯一容量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching c=3×10⁸ m/s and clock-bias magnitude 20 ns, defining sign separately. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: |δρ|=3×10⁸×20×10⁻⁹. Result ≈ 6 m. Pseudorange includes geometric range plus cδt; common receiver-clock bias is not a per-axis position error.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching windows are 0–30 and 20–50 min at a unique rate of 2 Mbit/s, excluding packet overhead. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: V=(30+30−10)×60×2/8. Result ≈ 750 MB. At fixed unique-data rate, capacity=union time×rate; duplicate reception does not add unique capacity.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
